author: Adyson p
title: Will not accept payment nor will Spotify work with me to accept my payment
content: I have tried multiple ways for Spotify to take my payment and made many attempts to contact them about the situation. ( I would never even receive an email back after the first initial messaging with their support team) I had even switched to apple music for a while to see if after a while it would allow me to pay for Spotify again. I love the selection of music that is offered and the way the app works… BUT I like to listen to music all the time and need to be able to listen if I have no service. It is ridiculous at this point. WORST CUSTOMER SERVICE!!!

author: No
content: Spotify's an app that I literally use everyday. Because I genuinely love listening to music, especially on this app. But lately it's hitting my nerve. Previously it was 1 add after 4 or 5 songs at max (The era everyone loved the most). And then, it became 2 adds back to back after 3 or 4 songs... Pretty reasonable. Which was okay with most of us because it seemed fair enough. But 3 adds back to back after barely completing 1 song is just absurd. Please fix this or else I'll have to switch. 🙏
